verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page says users can flip a switch to turn on dark mode and can use night light to reduce screen glare, which covers both halves of the story directly. The evidence is a single first-party marketing line with no deeper documentation or hands-on reports, so it is not best-in-class. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation (e.g., night light scheduling or configuration details), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can switch to dark mode or enable a night light to reduce eye strain

citations.quote: Flip a switch to turn on dark mode and give your eyes a break. Or use night light to reduce screen glare and help with sleep.
